{{Quote|I'm looking for my master. Have you seen him? I suppose you haven't unless you've visited the pirate hideout. Oh? You haven't heard? My master was kidnapped. Will you rescue him?|Demitri Firewatcher, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DF" />}}
'''Demitri Firewatcher''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Firewatcher's master was kidnapped by [[Naboo pirates|pirates]] and brought to their [[Pirate Bunker|bunker]] in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]]. Firewatcher stayed in [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], hoping to find help for his master until he finally met a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was willing to venture to the pirate's hideout and attempt a rescue operation. Demitri told him of treasures that were rumored to be found at this location. He then gave the spacer the approximate coordinates of the pirate bunker and waited for the spacer's return.<ref name="SWG:DF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Demitri Firewatcher was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Demitri Firewatcher was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>

Firewatcher was not part of a quest. He was one of the so-called [[W:c:swg:Herald NPC|Herald NPCs]], which were added to the game to point players to dungeons and other points of interest. When talking to Firewatcher, the player could decide whether to help him or decline his plea. If the player agreed to go to the pirate bunker, only a new waypoint was added to the player's datapad and it was up to the player if he wanted to explore this location. None of the prisoners in the bunker could be identified as Firewatcher's master. If the player freed the prisoners by talking to them after killing the pirates, Firewatcher's dialogue did not change.<ref name="SWG:DF" />
